title: Average query cost
statement: Let a randomized decision tree have a finite alphabet, and let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on that alphabet. Its average cost is the expected input cost when the $n$ input coordinates are sampled independently from $\pi$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability distribution on the alphabet.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of input cost, so its precise cost convention cannot be specified.
